desc: Read input values H, W, X, P, Q, and the grid S.
Initialize Takahashi's current strength with S[P-1][Q-1] (adjusting for 0-indexing).
Use a min-heap to store candidate slimes (strength, row, col) that are adjacent to Takahashi's current position.
Maintain a visited set to track which cells have been absorbed or are in the candidate heap.
While the heap is not empty, pop the slime with the smallest strength. If it has already been visited, skip it.

Check if the popped slime's strength is strictly less than current_strength / X. If not, since the heap is min-ordered, no other candidate can be absorbed either (because all others are >= this one), so we break.
If the condition is met, absorb the slime: add its strength to current_strength, mark it as visited, and add its unvisited neighbors to the heap.
After the loop, print the final current_strength.
